$comment: Windows-only overlay, merged over .claude/settings.json by setup_windows.ps1.
Top-level keys here win. Anything cross-platform belongs in settings.json,
sshConfigs is read by the Claude Desktop app only -- the CLI and the VS Code
extension ignore it. It pre-populates the environment dropdown so an SSH
session on syntopic is one click, with no dialog to fill in. Desktop resolves
the host through ~/.ssh/config, so the ProxyJump through cloudflared that the
syntopic alias already carries is honoured; there is nothing to duplicate here.
Anything true of this machine rather than of Windows -- voice dictation, which
needs a microphone this box happens to have -- goes in the gitignored
settings.local.json next to this file, which is applied after this one.
